# Native reception and aggregation in Monitor

Within the same Monitor process, rclcpp handles serialized message reception and window aggregation,
while Python handles graph/QoS, API/SSE, status, baseline learning, and alerts.
Payloads are neither decoded nor transferred to Python. Monitored topics are not reduced, and received messages are not subsampled.

## Build

The normal `make build monitor` builds the shared library and bundles it in the image.
No compilation or downloads are needed at startup. Custom messages use the
`install/` generated by the existing `make msgs-build`, without changes.

The default backend is `native`. To switch back for maintenance, set
`KAIROS_MONITOR_BACKEND=python` in `.env` and recreate the Monitor container.
A missing shared library or an ABI mismatch does not silently trigger a fallback to Python.

## Verifying the distribution image

After building, run the following from the repository root. The tests cover numerical comparison with Python using a fixed random seed,
actual ROS reception, additional topics, QoS changes, pause/resume, restarts, the ABI, and failure paths.
Normal operation does not require pause. Publish only after confirming DDS discovery has completed.

```bash
docker run --rm --network none \
  -e ROS_DOMAIN_ID=97 -e ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST \
  -e RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp \
  -v "$PWD/services/topic_monitor/native:/tests:ro" \
  "kairos-topic-monitor:$(cat VERSION)-jazzy" \
  python /tests/verify_native.py
```

Run the same tests with `RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp` as well.
ROS integration CI also uses this command to verify the library inside the distribution image.

## Meaning of the observed values

- `messages_total` is the cumulative received count; Hz uses the same calculation as before: received message count in the window divided by the window duration.
- `dds_samples_lost` represents middleware lost events. It is not a measurement that guarantees detection of all publisher or rosbag losses.
- Python callback processing time cannot be measured, so the self-load callback values are `null`.
- Stamp delay and sensor preview are `null`. Unmeasured values are not fabricated.
- The ABI version and snapshot structure size are checked between C++ and ctypes. Use artifacts from the same build.

See the [topic_monitor specification](../../../docs/specs/en/topic_monitor.md) for the detailed contract.
